Results.ReviewText:
We purchased our e310 three burner grill from our local Target and assembled it at home. There was damage to the hood and one of the grill grates that must have occurred during rough handling during shipping before we made our purchase.
We contacted Weber customer service and provided photos of the damage to support our request for replacement parts. Without a hassle of any kind, Weber mailed us the replacement parts withing about a week and our grill is as perfect as expected when we bought it.
In addition, this is the best grill we've ever had! Even heating and precise control over the flame level(s) have given us a new appreciation for outdoor cooking.
We highly recommend Weber!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Ordered from home depot. When I unpacked the parts to assemble it, the two main pieces of the frame were bent. I called customer service. I had the grill registered and replacement parts ordered within a half hour or so.
It took a couple of days to get the parts and about an hour and forty five minutes to assemble. It went together well and I could tell the difference in quality from other grills I have assembled.
Cooking in it is a dream. When I preheated it for the first time. It only took five minutes to get to 550 degrees. I had two t bones seared and resting in ten minutes.
Well worth the extra investment to buy a Weber. Love it!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I received this bbq as a gift a couple of months ago and it works great (consistent temp across the grill and easily adjustable to the temp I want). Unfortunately, here are a couple of places where they seem to have gone cheap. 

The two areas i feel could have been better are the wheels, which are held on by small cotter pins, and the fold down side “table”. I have had the wheels come off when moving the grill, which just shouldn’t happen. For the foldable side, it has these guide holes that go over some bolts to hold it up; the metal is fairly thin so it can flex and not stay on those rails/guides. This is more of an issue when moving the bbq as the foldable side is also the side that you have to lift when moving the bbq (it’s opposite the wheels) and it too easily misses getting locked in due to the folding ability.

Other than those two issues, the bbq has been great and has a good build quality.
Results.Title: Great bbq with a couple of small issues

Through many substandard grills,  frustrating me , I came back to Weber. I will never ever take the cheap road. My Weber rocks!! Steaks, seafood etc. are done effortlessly and like a pro. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have owned this BBQ for about 3 months and have had many compliments on the quality of the BBQ as well as the appearance of the BBQ.  It was relatively easy to assemble for a non DIY'er and worked perfectly on the first use and has ever since.  I fine the three grills are very effective as I can cook steaks at high temps and also cook more delicate foods by using the indirect heat using only 1 or 2 grills and cooking over the unused grill area.

I have been BBQ'ing for over 50 years starting with charcoal in a garbage can lid so have many years of experience and this is one of the best grills I have used.
Results.Title: Great BBQ for smaller areas and two people

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: My wife convinced me to spend the money and buy a Weber when older kenmore grill but the dust. I’ve always heard good things about Weber but never wanted to spend the money when I could get others fore almost half. Well I am glad I did. Only used it a few times but this thing is awesome. Nice easy to control even heat throughout cooks things perfectly. A ten year warranty certainly helps ease my mind about the initial cost. Only thing I would change is to add a side burner to the smaller models.
Results.Title: Overall great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
After replacing grills every few years that really never cooked consistently to begin with, all I can say is Wow!  I've only had this grill for a couple of months, but what a difference.  Everything I've cooked on it has come out perfect.  No more half cooked/over cooked items from uneven heat.  My family has even made compliments on the quality of the burgers and chicken, the only difference was the grill, the recipe has remained the same.

The fold out shelf is very convenient when needed, and simple to get out of the way for storage.  Only two suggestions.

1. The accessories hooks on the side are too shallow.  Anything I have hanging on them gets knocked off every time I remove the cover.

2. I struggle with finding a good place to hold the grill when I want to move it around.  I hesitate to use the folding shelf.  It's sturdy enough but I know it's not meant to be a handle.

I look forward to seeing how it stands up over the years.  From the construction quality I think it should do so very well.
Results.Title: I'm convinced...Weber is better

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Over the last two years I replaced the grates and gas system including manifold on my 1990s era Genesis, but two decades of harsh midwestern weather finally were too much.  We decided to look for a new grill; being condo dwellers we have to stay with gas and we also wanted a smaller footprint so the Spirit with three gas jets was a good fit.  I found one in the red color we wanted at a local independent garden store and they assembled it for free and I picked it up and had it within 2 hours of the call.  
It's I like the collapsible left side shelf and have been using it now for over a month.  It does not seem to get as hot as the Genesis did, but I have no issues with its ability to sear meat and the grill grate surfaces seem easier to clean.   A recent birthday gift of the LED handle light has been a great addition; it works perfectly and provides ample light for the cooking surface.
Results.Title: A worthy replacement for a trusted Weber Genesis

Photos.Caption: USDA Choice ribeye steak with bone!

Results.ReviewText:
This is my first gas grill, I have ever used. I have always been a charcoal guy and never thought anything of a gas grill. That changed with this beautiful Weber grill. Things are made so easily and they come out surprisingly like the food I used to make on my charcoal grill minus the smokiness. There is a trick to getting a smoke flavor in your meat and that is light a small coal and throw a couple drops of oil on it. The smoke that comes out from the oil and coal will flavor your food to your liking. Overall thank you so much Weber for making such a awesome grill. 
I actually made some rib eye steaks on it and they came out melting in your mouth. Here are a couple of pictures!
Results.Title: Fantastic Grill

Quick call to customer service and due to the fact that I live in Chicagoland area the parts were delivered next day. Assembly didn’t take long, everything lines up precisely, all the parts are labeled and instructions are dead on. There’s even a software with video how to assemble on line for those who need that. Results.ReviewText: This replaced a two burner, 10 year old "Spirit" which I loved. What a disappointment. Tough to ignite and when it does it is an alarming burst of flame. Takes forever to get to 400+ degrees. Fuel gauge is useless -- always reads full even when grill goes out because tank is empty. But worst feature is the grease tray is directly under the open fire so every time I cook ANYTHING the grease tray ignites and the grill fire box is on fire -- even when I change the grease tray each time I use the grill. This is a SERIOUS SAFETY ISSUE!!!  The older Spirit had a completely different grease tray system that was safe -- in ten years it never caught on fire, this is just dangerous cost cutting.
Results.Title: Terrible Design

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Got this from the family as a Father's Day gift this year, a friendly nudge that my 17-year old Weber Silver B needed to be put to pasture. At first I thought it might be too small, but it has been absolutely fine. I am the king of a family of five and there is plenty of room to grill meats and vegetables for all of us at the same time. The grill of Silver B was rectangular, with the 3 burners running horizontally; the E-310's burners go top to bottom, which I think makes more sense. It allows for grilling wider foods when grilling indirectly. This grill is definitely a bargain; the grilling area  is only marginally smaller than other Weber models that are $300 more expensive. The one thing I miss is that on the Silver B had fold-out tables on each side, giving me lots of room for bowls, utensils, etc. I don't think any of the newer models have them, though. I would suggest bringing them back. One other small comment is that the hooks for the utensils are a little small and the utensils fall off the side of the grill a little more easily than they used to. But these are all small grievances. This is a great grill at a bargain price and I'm looking forward to making many masterpieces on it.
Results.Title: Hendrix had his Fender; I have my Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill about three weeks ago. I'm loving it! I've grilled tri-tip roasts twice, and each time they were the best that I've ever made. I'm really liking the three burners, which lets me utilize both indirect and direct heat at the same time, which expands my ability to cook different foods at once. I had a Weber Q100 before, which was great...but I needed to upgrade. I read several online reviews before purchasing this grill (America's Test Kitchen Review, Consumer Reports, The Wirecutter, Cooks Illustrated, etc.) because I wanted to get the best. They all pointed to this very grill, and I have to say...they were absolutely right. Foods are evenly cooked every time. The only tricky thing is getting used to the how long things should be cooked in the higher heat, which is natural and is something I will eventually get the hang off.
Results.Title: Makes amazing food!
